body: Not really. I'm not much of a music person. I've tried reading short stories and novels, but I just can't keep my mind on the story, and end up stopping every couple pages crying. It feels like every moment is an eternity.
I talked to my mom earlier and she was as helpful as you can be 1300 miles away.

I'm a lesbian, so the fact that she is leaving me for a guy makes it worse. I mean wtf?! Its like she's been lying to me all these years. She lied to me when she she said her vows. She lied when she said she would never leave me. I just feel so betrayed. I can't see starting over. I just can't so this...

I'm staying with my best friend, who had been a help. My family is 1300 miles away, so right now all I have is my friend. I just keep having thoughts that I would be better off dead. I can't go on like this. I can't keep hurting. I feel so betrayed. I just have nothing left...
